name: isoligne
description: Verified, dated data about French companies: website AI-readability scores, sector benchmarks, and exact prices from published price grids.

interface.longDescription:
Isoligne gives ChatGPT verified, dated data about French companies, measured or published at the source.

- Website analytics: the published Agent Readiness Score of a company website (how much of it an AI assistant can read and understand), axis by axis, with its date and method; what lowers it; and which buying questions none of its pages answer.
- Sector benchmarks: how the published websites of a sector rank (insurance, wine, energy, higher education, training, e-commerce, software).
- Price data: the exact price of a specific case (quantities, options, period), calculated line by line on the price grid a company publishes with Isoligne, with its source and date. A missing quantity is never guessed: the answer says which one to provide.

Read-only, no account, no key. Only published data is served: a domain absent from the index has not been measured or published, which says nothing about its quality. Answers are in French.
capabilities: Look up the published AI readability score of a company website
Explain what lowers a website's score, with measured evidence
Benchmark the published websites of a sector
Calculate an exact price on a company's published price grid
defaultPrompt: Combien coûte chez Tonton Gégé le stockage de 900 bouteilles en 18 références par mois ?
Quelle est la note Isoligne de maif.fr, et qu'est-ce qui l'abaisse ?
Classe les sites d'assurance de l'Index Isoligne.

positive.description: Exact price on a client's published grid
positive.prompt: Combien coûte chez Tonton Gégé le stockage de 900 bouteilles en 18 références par mois ?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers 99 € HT per month, calculated line by line (18 × 4 € + 900 × 0,03 €), with the source URL and date of the published price grid.

positive.description: Published AI readability score of a website
positive.prompt: Quelle est la note Isoligne de maif.fr ?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a score out of 100 for maif.fr, the detail per axis and the measurement date.

positive.prompt: Qu'est-ce qui abaisse la note Isoligne de maif.fr ?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the weakest axes of maif.fr, each with its measured finding, and the buying questions no page can answer.

positive.prompt: Classe les sites d'assurance de l'Index Isoligne.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 14 published insurance websites grouped by score level, without separating scores less than 5 points apart.
Lists the 7 sectors of the index with their number of published websites.

negative.description: Running a new audit on demand: the connector only serves published measurements and must point to isoligne.com/audit instead of auditing.
Price question without quantities: the price must not be guessed; the answer asks for the missing quantities.
negative.prompt: Combien coûte le stockage chez Tonton Gégé ?

negative.description: Placing an order: no tool orders or writes anything; the assistant must not claim an order was placed.

publication.release_notes: First release: published scores, gaps, sector rankings and exact price calculation.

fr-FR.subtitle: Données vérifiées d'entreprise
fr-FR.description: Isoligne mesure ce que les assistants IA peuvent lire des sites d'entreprises, et sert aux assistants les informations que ces entreprises déclarent elles-mêmes. Avec Isoligne, ChatGPT peut donner la note publiée d'un site, ce qui l'abaisse, le classement d'un secteur, et calculer le prix exact d'un cas précis sur la grille publiée d'une entreprise cliente d'Isoligne, ligne par ligne, avec sa source et sa date. Lecture seule, sans compte ni clé.
